{{Top|leg}}
An '''I/O jack''', '''computer interface jack''', '''input jack''',<ref name="RSeries">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> or '''computer data-jack'''<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> was a type of interface jack by which some [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], can control a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] with their [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]]. These jacks were installed into various computer-based systems as a secondary control mechanism in the event that a computer was made inoperable.

==History==
This type of jack was included on the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] computer of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] used this I/O jack during a conversation with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] about the requisite skills to pilot [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Darryn Thyte]] had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm that included a jack which allowed him to access computer information as long as there was a display screen.<ref name="TDC" />
